docs.title: 🏠 Welcome to Finauto Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to the official Finauto Help & User Guide.

This documentation is designed to serve as a comprehensive support system for users of the Finauto Client Software, offering detailed step-by-step guidance for each module and feature.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose of This Documentation
docs.text:
• 📚 To provide a complete reference manual for navigating and using each feature of the Finauto software.
  • 🖱️ To assist users in real-time with contextual help icons embedded in the software UI.
  • 🔧 To explain all configurations, imports, reports, and settings for maximum productivity.
  • 📤 To guide first-time setup, ongoing usage, and troubleshooting.

docs.title: 🧭 How to Use This Documentation
docs.text:
• Each module in the Finauto client comes with a 🛈 Help icon. Clicking this icon will open the exact section in this documentation related to that module.
  • The documentation is continuously updated as new features are added or enhanced.
  • Use the left sidebar to browse major modules, or search any keyword in the top bar.

docs.title: 🧩 Key Modules Covered
docs.text:
• Company Master Setup
  • Share Capital Imports
  • Trial Balance Coding & Imports
  • Fixed Assets Register
  • Aging Reports
  • Cloud Mode & Tally Settings
  • API Key Updates
  • CA Profile Creation
  • ... and more

docs.title: 🔄 Stay Updated
docs.text:
We recommend checking this documentation regularly after software updates, as new features and workflows are documented with examples and screenshots.

For login to your software client: 🔗 https://www.finautoindia.com/user/login

📞 Need help not listed here? Contact our support team through your software dashboard or email us directly.

Happy filing with Finauto!

docs.title: 🛠️ Installation Process – Finauto
docs.text: This guide walks you through the complete installation process of the Finauto Client Software, from registration to setting up Tally integration.

docs.title: 🔐 1. Create Your Login Profile
docs.text:
To get started:

  • Visit: 🔗 https://www.finautoindia.com
  • Click on the Try Now tab to register and create your login credentials.
  • Once registered, your login profile will be created and activated.

docs.title: 🔑 2. Existing Users – Direct Login
docs.text:
If you already have a login profile:

  • Go to 🔗 https://www.finautoindia.com/user/login
  • Enter your registered email and use the OTP received in your inbox.
  • You'll be redirected to your personal user dashboard.

docs.title: 💾 3. Download & Install the Client Software
docs.text:
• After logging in, go to the Downloads section.
  • Download the latest .exe installer.
  • Run the installer. After installation, you'll see a desktop icon: 🖥️ Finauto Client

docs.title: 📁 4. Dashboard Features After Login
docs.text:
Once logged in, your dashboard will display:

  • Current Subscription Track your plan, activation status, and eligible entities.

  • Demo Data (Excel) A ZIP file to test the software with sample Excel imports.

  • Demo Data (Tally) For testing Tally integration with vouchers, ledgers, etc.

  • Templates Section Download templates for accounting policies and notes. These can be imported into the client software via: Reports → Customise → Import.

docs.title: 🔌 5. Setup Tally Plugin (tcodes.tcp)
docs.text:
Before starting, add the Finauto plugin in Tally:

  1. Open Tally and go to Help → F4: Add-Ons.
  2. Add the plugin path: C:\Users\Win10\AppData\Local\Programs\Finauto Client\tcodes.tcp

✅ A screenshot is provided below to guide plugin placement.

docs.title: 🔌6. Set Up the ODBC Settings in Tally
docs.text:
a. Open Tally.

b. Navigate to: Help → Settings → Connectivity → Client/Server Configuration

c. Under Client/Server Configuration, select "Both" as the mode.

d. Press Enter repeatedly to exit and save the configuration.

🟢 You should see the message: "Restart Tally to apply the changes."

✅ A screenshot is provided below to guide you through the ODBC setup in Tally.

docs.title: 🚀 7. You're Ready to Use the Software
docs.text:
The Finauto Client is now installed and connected with Tally.

Each feature inside the client software is guided with a 🛈 Help icon, linking directly to this documentation for step-by-step guidance.

Enjoy seamless automation and simplified financial reporting with Finauto.

docs.title: 🧩 Step 8: Manual Ledger Code Assignment (If Carry Code / Auto Code not used)
docs.text: After the software is ready to use and installed successfully, you must ensure that all ledgers in Tally have proper codes assigned for accurate financial statement generation.

docs.title: 📝 Instructions:
docs.text:
1. Login to Finauto client portal at 🔗 https://www.finautoindia.com/user/login
  2. Download the file named tally_codes under your login dashboard.
  3. Open Tally and go to the custom code field (activated via plugin) under ledger configuration.
  4. Manually enter the codes as shown in the tally_codes file.

📌 Note: This step is only required if: - 🛑 You are not using the Carry Code feature. - 🛑 You are not using the Auto Code feature.

docs.title: 🧠 Additional Features for Tally users:
docs.text:
• 🗂️ Codes can also be assigned at the group level — specifically the last level group (i.e., the group just above the ledger).

  • ✅ If a code is assigned at the group level, all ledgers under that group will automatically inherit the group code.

  • ⭐ Special Treatment Ledgers: Users can assign special codes for ledgers that require custom presentation or grouping treatment in the generated financial statements.

  • 🔁 Auto Group-Level Code Assignment:

  • If the Tally plugin (tcodes.tcp) is installed and remains active, any new ledger created under an already-coded group will automatically receive the group’s code.
  • Similarly, when a ledger is moved from one group to another, the ledger’s code is automatically updated based on the new group code.

docs.title: ⚠️ Warning:
docs.text:
If any ledger with an opening or closing balance is not assigned a code, an error will appear in the Finauto client during Balance Sheet generation, indicating unclassified ledgers.

📸 Refer to the screenshots below for:

  • Group/Ledger code entry screen in Tally.

  • Error prompt shown in the Finauto client if codes are missing.

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
📘 Software Overview – Finauto

Welcome to Finauto, your intelligent automation platform for preparing financial statements, regulatory reports, and audit-ready schedules — all in one place. Designed for CAs, accounting professionals, and corporate users, Finauto bridges the gap between raw accounting data and polished, compliant financial outputs.

🚀 What Finauto Does

Finauto streamlines and automates the entire backend of statutory financial reporting by:

  • Importing and processing accounting data from Tally, Excel, or other ERPs

  • Generating Schedule III-compliant financial statements

  • Auto-plotting reports like Trial Balance, Fixed Assets Register, Share Capital, Aging Reports, and more

  • Enabling easy configuration for quarterly, half-yearly, or annual reports

  • Supporting cloud-based and local processing modes for faster troubleshooting and performance

🔍Key Modules at a Glance Module Description 💼 Company Master Create/edit companies with PAN, select depreciation method (SLM/WDV), and assign CA profiles. 🏦 Share Capital Import shareholder data using templates and manage changes via Tax Transfer logs. 🛠️ Fixed Assets Build PPE register using WDV from audit, import additions from Tally or Excel. 📋 Trial Balance Import from Tally/Excel, view and edit ledgers, and auto-code for schedule mapping. ⏱️ Aging Reports Generate aging data using vouchers imported from Tally or Excel. 🔐 API Key Settings Update API key every 30 days via Finauto Login. 👨‍💼 CA Profiles Create and assign CA profiles for printing in balance sheet salutation. ☁️ Cloud Mode Enable cloud generation for faster reports and remote troubleshooting. 🧭 Tally Settings Set Tally install path and default ODBC port (9000) for integration. ⚡ Seamless Integration & Automation

Whether you're importing from Tally or working on Excel-based records, Finauto adapts with:

  • Auto-coding of trial balance items

  • Customizable templates for each report type

  • Audit-ready notes and schedules with zero manual formatting

  • One-click EXE updates to ensure your software is always current

🔐 Secure & Configurable

  • 🔑 API Key authentication ensures secure integration

  • 🧩 Multiple configuration options for report frequency and cloud enablement

  • 🛠️ Custom depreciation logic, asset categorization, and trial balance codes

📈 Why Finauto?

✅ Eliminates repetitive data entry

✅ Ensures compliance with the Companies Act, 2013

✅ Simplifies collaboration between clients and auditors

✅ Saves time for firms handling multiple clients

✅ Supports CA firm branding in financial outputs

🌐 Get Started?

👉 Login to Finauto

👉 Start by importing your Trial Balance, configuring your Company Master, and enabling key modules like Fixed Assets and Share Capital.

docs.title: Aging Report
docs.text:
📊 Aging Report The Aging Report helps in tracking outstanding balances and overdue amounts. It is generated based on voucher entries imported into the software.

📥 Voucher Import for Aging 🧾 Tally Users When importing data from Tally, vouchers are automatically imported along with other records.

Make sure the option “Import Data for Aging” is checked during Tally data import.

Vouchers are used to calculate the outstanding amounts and due periods.

📄 Non-Tally Users For non-Tally users, voucher data can be imported through Excel templates.

Go to Ageing → Vouchers.

Download the template from the bottom of the screen.

Fill in the required voucher details and import using the provided tool.

📈 Viewing Aging Reports Navigate to the “Ageing” tab in the software to view reports.

Reports are automatically plotted in the financial statements generated by the system.

Outstanding balances are grouped by duration (e.g., 0–30 days, 31–60 days, etc.).

🔁 Handling Previous Year Balances If there are balances outstanding for more than one year, import previous year’s data as well.

This ensures accurate and complete aging analysis.

docs.title: Register
docs.text:
🏢 Fixed Assets Tab

The Fixed Assets module is used to manage, track, and present Property, Plant & Equipment (PPE) data in financial reports.

🗂️ Step 1: Importing the Fixed Asset Register

To begin, import the latest audited Fixed Asset Register using the available Excel template.

📄 How to Import:

Navigate to Fixed Assets → Register.

Scroll to the bottom and download the Excel template provided.

Fill in the asset-wise data in the template.

Upload the completed file through the Import from Excel option.

⚠️ Important: On first-time import, make sure to enter the last Written Down Value (WDV) of each asset as per your audited accounts. Refer to the screenshot below for the WDV input field.

🔁 ⚙️ Depreciation Method Selection

📝 Note: It is mandatory to select the Depreciation Method — either SLM (Straight Line Method) or WDV (Written Down Value) — when creating or editing a Company Master.

This dropdown is available in the Company Master screen.

Once selected, the method will be applied across all PPE calculations and schedules.

🔁 Step 2: Importing Year-on-Year Additions

Once the base register is imported:

Tally Users: Can import yearly additions directly via the Import tab integrated with Tally.

Non-Tally Users: Use the same Excel template to add new asset entries for the relevant year.

This ensures the Fixed Asset Register remains updated annually.

📊 Step 3: Fixed Assets in Financial Statements

The final PPE Register is automatically plotted in the Financial Statements.

!

A detailed PPE Notes section is generated, providing:

Asset-wise details

Opening balances

Additions

Depreciation

Closing WDV

📌 Summary Feature Tally Users Excel Import Users Initial Import Excel Template Excel Template Yearly Additions Tally → Import Tab Excel Template Auto Plot in Financials ✅ Yes ✅ Yes PPE Notes (Schedule II Format) ✅ Yes ✅ Yes

docs.title: Import Process
docs.text:
📘 Share Capital Import Process

This guide outlines the steps to import share capital details into the software using an Excel template.

🧭 Step 1: Navigate to the Share Tab

Open the client software.

Click on the "Share" tab from the main menu.

📥 Step 2: Download Excel Template

Go to Subscribed → Share Capital section.

Scroll to the bottom of the page.

Click on "Download Excel Template" to get the format for share capital data entry.

📊 Step 3: Import Share Data

Fill in the share details in the downloaded Excel file.

Navigate to Import → Import from Excel under the Share Capital tab.

Upload the completed file and follow the on-screen instructions to import.

🧾 Step 4: Update Holder Categories After import, go to the Holder List.

Select the category for each shareholder (e.g., Promoter, Holding Company, etc.).

🔄 Step 5: Manage Changes in Future Years In subsequent years, if new shareholders are added or existing ones retire:

Go to Tax Transfer Logs under the Share Capital tab.

Make necessary adjustments to reflect changes in shareholding.

docs.title: View Ledgers & Stock items
docs.text:
📋 Trial Balance View

The Trial Balance View tab provides a consolidated view of all ledger balances imported into the software, including financial and stock ledgers.

📥 What You Can View:

  • Complete Trial Balance imported from:

    -Tally (if integrated)

    -Excel (for non-Tally users)

  • Stock Ledgers along with regular ledgers with Groups and sub-groups

✏️ Edit Ledger Entries Each ledger entry can be individually edited if needed.

To edit a ledger:

  1. Navigate to the Trial Balance View tab.

  2. Click the ✏️ Edit button next to the ledger you want to modify.

  3. Make the necessary changes in the popup or side panel.

  4. Click Save to update the ledger details.

🔁 Real-Time Update Changes made to ledger entries are reflected instantly in the:

  • Trial Balance view

  • Linked reports and statements

docs.title: 🌟 Advanced Features
docs.text: The Advanced Usage of Finauto builds upon the basic functionality by enabling additional core modules for a more complete financial reporting experience.

docs.title: ✅ What’s Included
docs.text:
In addition to everything covered under Basic Usage, the advanced setup includes:

  • 🧾 Fixed Assets Module Enables creation and management of a full PPE Register, along with automatic calculation of depreciation and plotting of the PPE Notes in the Balance Sheet.

  • 💼 Share Capital Module Allows importing and updating shareholder details, categorizing them (e.g. Promoter, Holding Company), and managing capital movements year-on-year through Tax Transfer Logs.

docs.title: 📚 Learn More
docs.text:
• 🔗 View Fixed Assets Module
  • 🔗 View Share Capital Module

💡 These modules are designed to support complete statutory compliance and deeper reporting insights as per financial reporting standards.

docs.title: 🚀 Basic Usage of the Software
docs.text: Finauto is designed for quick and efficient financial report generation with minimal setup.

docs.title: 📥 Step 1: Download Sample Data
docs.text:
Users can log in to their customer profile at 🔗 https://www.finautoindia.com/user/login and download any of the following from the dashboard:

  • 📁 Excel Sample Data (Demo Data - Excel)
  • 🧾 Tally Sample Data (Demo Data - Tally)
  • 🗜️ Zip Files containing prefilled trial balance and ledgers

These help in testing the software's functionalities without first entering detailed company setups.

docs.title: 📊 Step 2: Auto-Generated Financial Reports
docs.text:
Once data is imported, the following reports are automatically generated:

  • 📄 Balance Sheet
  • 📈 Cash Flow Statement
  • 📉 Profit & Loss Statement
  • 📌 BS Notes (Balance Sheet Notes)
  • 📌 PL Notes (Profit & Loss Notes)
  • 🧮 Balance Sheet & P&L Groupings

docs.title: ⚠️ Not Included in Basic Usage
docs.text:
This basic process does not include: - Setting up the PPE (Fixed Asset) Schedule or related PPE Notes - Entering Shareholder details under Share Capital

These advanced features can be configured later via their respective modules in the software.

💡 Use this method to quickly test the software's reporting capabilities before going deeper into module-wise configurations.

docs.title: CA Profiles
docs.text:
The CA Profiles tab allows you to create and manage Chartered Accountant (CA) profiles used across the system.

🧾 Purpose CA profiles are used to assign a practicing Chartered Accountant to companies. The assigned CA’s details will be printed in the Balance Sheet salutation when the statement is generated.

🛠️ How to Create a CA Profile Go to Configuration → CA Profiles.

Click on "Add New" or the ➕ button.

Enter the required details:

Name of the CA

Firm Name

Membership Number

Address / Contact details (optional)

Click Save.

🔗 Linking with Company Master After a CA profile is created, go to Company Master.

Select the company to which the CA is to be assigned.

Choose the desired CA from the CA Profile dropdown.

Save the changes.

📄 Where It Appears The selected CA’s name and firm will appear at the bottom of the Balance Sheet, under the salutation or certification section.

docs.title: Company Master
docs.text:
🏢 Company Master The Company Master is a key setup section used across all modules in the software.

📥 Tally Import Method When data is imported from Tally, the Company Master is automatically created.

Ensure PAN is entered in Tally → F11: Features → Statutory & Taxation.

If PAN is missing, the Company Master will not be generated during import.

➕ Manual Creation Method For non-Tally imports (e.g., Excel), you must create the Company Master manually.

Go to the Company Master section in the software.

Click the ➕ (plus sign) to add a new company.

Enter:

Company Name

PAN (mandatory)

Other details like CA, address or contact, Director DIN (optional)

Click SubmitSave to complete.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
⚙️ Settings Tab

The Settings Tab includes various configuration options that help the user control data access, report generation behavior, and integration settings.

🔑 API Key

This option allows users to update their API key every 30 days.

The key is generated through the Finauto client login.

Steps: Visit: Login to Finauto Client

Login with your credentials.

Generate a new API key.

📅 Enable Quarterly or Half-Yearly Balance Sheets:

Tick this checkbox if you want to generate Balance Sheets on a Quarterly or Half-Yearly basis.

Once enabled, reporting options will allow period-specific balance sheet views.

☁️ Generate Reports in Cloud

Enable this option to generate reports on the cloud for:

Faster performance

Easier troubleshooting

Quicker resolution of balance sheet errors

Recommended for larger files or users needing remote support.

🤖 Enable Auto Code Feature

Use this to auto-code your Trial Balance:

Automatically maps ledgers using preset logic.

Saves time during Excel imports or when codes are missing in Tally.

Use Cases:

No manual code entry in Tally required.

Avoid manual punching in Excel Trial Balances.

📁 Tally Settings

Tally Install Location

Specify the folder where Tally is installed.

Example: C:\Program Files\TallyPrime

Tally ODBC Port:

This must be set to 9000, which is Tally's default ODBC port.

Required for Tally-to-software connectivity.

docs.title: Updates
docs.text:
🔄 Update Tab The Update tab alerts users whenever a new version of the software is available.

🔔 How It Works When a new version is released, the Update tab will show a notification.

Users are prompted to update to the latest version to access new features and improvements.

📥 Downloading and Installing the Update Click the Update button when notified.

The new .exe file will be automatically downloaded.

Run the downloaded file to install the new version.

Once installation is complete, the updated version of the software is ready to use.

⚠️ Ensure all work is saved before starting the update to avoid data loss.

✅ Benefits of Updating Access to the latest features and improvements

Bug fixes and performance enhancements

Compatibility with newer modules or data formats

docs.title: 1. What does the issue
docs.text:
"Tally Connection Error: Ensure that Tally is running ODBC server on port: 9000" mean?

Answer: This error indicates that:

  • The Tally software is not running, or
  • The ODBC setting (port 9000) is not enabled in Tally, or
  • The Finauto plugin (tcodes.tcp) has not been installed correctly in Tally.

📌 To resolve this: - Ensure Tally is open and the ODBC port (9000) is active. - Check if the plugin is added in Tally via Help → F4 Add-Ons.

  • View ODBC Setup under installation

docs.title: 2 What does
docs.text:
"Finauto username and/or password is not valid. Please configure from Configuration → Settings" mean?

Answer: This means:

  • Your Finauto API key has expired, or
  • It has been regenerated by another user in your organization.

📌 To resolve this: - Generate a new API key from your login at 🔗 https://www.finautoindia.com/user/login - Go to Configuration → Settings in the client software. - Paste the new API key and click the "Update" button under Service Settings.

docs.title: 3. Does Fianuto have Rounding off feature to convert the Balance Sheet values into denominations like Hundreds, Thousands, Lakhs, or Millions?
docs.text:
Ans: ✅ Yes, Finauto facilitates this feature conveniently.

After generating the Balance Sheet in Excel format, you will find a file named:

📄 MASTER SHEET

Inside the MASTER SHEET:

  • Cell F1 displays the label: Convert To
  • Cell F2 provides a dropdown menu to select your preferred denomination:
    • Hundreds
    • Thousands
    • Lakhs
    • Millions

This allows you to instantly convert the entire balance sheet figures to a desired scale for reporting or presentation purposes.

💡 No need to modify formulas manually — the conversion is automated based on your selection!

docs.title: 4. What does the issue "Income tax number not set" mean?
docs.text:
Ans: ⚠️ This error occurs when the PAN (Permanent Account Number) is not configured in Tally.

To resolve this:

  1. Open Tally.
  2. Navigate to F11 → Features.
  3. Go to More Details.
  4. Ensure the PAN field is correctly filled in.

🔍 PAN is a mandatory field required by Finauto to fetch or validate income tax-related data from Tally.

docs.title: 5. What is the purpose of the tcodes.tcp plugin in Tally?
docs.text: → Enables integration between Tally and Finauto for auto-import and API sync.

docs.title: 6. How to import share capital data?
docs.text: → Use Excel template under Share Capital → Import → Excel Import, then update holder type and transfer logs.

docs.title: 7. What if vouchers aren't showing in the aging report?
docs.text: → Ensure "Import data for aging" is checked or use the Excel template under Ageing → Vouchers.

docs.title: 8. How is depreciation method (SLM or WDV) selected in Finauto?
docs.text: → This is selected in the Company Master (Edit/Create) using a dropdown.

docs.title: 9. How often should I update the API key?
docs.text: → Every 30 days via the login portal and updated under Configuration → Settings.

docs.title: 10.What is 'Enable Auto Code Feature' used for?
docs.text: → Automatically assigns codes to trial balance lines for classification, avoiding manual mapping.

docs.title: 11.What is the "Carry Code" feature and how does it work?
docs.text:
The Carry Code feature in Finauto ensures consistency in ledger classification year-on-year.

It performs the following actions:

  • ✅ Auto-applies the same ledger codes from the previous financial year to current year ledgers if the ledger names match.
  • 🔄 Tracks changes in debit and credit balances and adjusts mapping accordingly.
  • 🧠 Saves users time by avoiding repeated manual classification of ledgers each year.

💡 Tip: Ensure the previous year's trial balance is properly imported and classified so that the Carry Code feature

docs.title: → Improves speed and error tracing when troubleshooting or generating reports.
